g.text: Back-of-the-envelope+: what can a fixed qubit budget buy?

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: One week · p = 10⁻³ · ε = 0.01 absolute sensitivity · 10 ns gates / 240 ns code cycles

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: Bands: declared scenarios, not confidence intervals. Effective NISQ overhead is assumed; Trotter and mitigation biases are assumed affordable.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: STAR uses termwise Strang; FTQC uses plaquettes; NISQ uses a Willow-anchored proxy. Even L only; full-lattice costs, without physical-cone truncation.
